definitions.gloss: oneself (emphatic, following a noun or pronoun)
definitions.explanation: Attaches directly to a person word or pronoun to stress that this very person, and no one else, is meant: {私|わたし}{自身|じしん} (I myself), {社長|しゃちょう}{自身|じしん} (the president himself). It does not stand alone as a subject.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}{自身|じしん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧{自身|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ことだ。
examples.english: That is something he decided himself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧{自身|じしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: The manager explained at a press conference that the player himself had decided to retire.

notes:
{自身|じしん} follows the word it emphasizes with no particle in between. It is used with people; for a thing or an abstract noun, Japanese uses ⟦{自体|じたい}→自体：30364_jitai⟧ instead (⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦{自体|じたい}→自体：30364_jitai⟧, the system itself).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {私|わたし}{自身|じしん}: I myself
- {自分|じぶん}{自身|じしん}: one's own self (a very common doubled form)
- {自身|じしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: one's own experience
- {自身|じしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確|たし}かめる→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧: to check for oneself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧: oneself — can stand alone as a subject or object; {自身|じしん} cannot
- ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧: personally, of one's own accord — an adverb stressing that one acted without being told
